skill_name: Research about the events of the American Civil War and classify them into categories.
workflow: The American Civil War began in 1861 and ended in 1865. During this period, numerous events shaped the war and influenced its outcome. These events can be classified into several categories. Political events include the Lincoln-Douglas debates, the election of Abraham Lincoln and the secession of the Southern states.
